tabs.label: Baseline vs noise
tabs.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN experiment LIKE '%noise' THEN 'noise' ELSE 'baseline' END AS state, var_nodes, msg_size, AVG("0_Avg-Duration_s") * 1000.0 AS avg_duration_ms FROM app_0 GROUP BY state, var_nodes, msg_size ORDER BY msg_size, var_nodes, state

tabs.label: Per repetition
tabs.sql: SELECT substr(experiment, 1, instr(experiment, '_') - 1) AS rep, CASE WHEN experiment LIKE '%noise' THEN 'noise' ELSE 'baseline' END AS state, var_nodes, msg_size, AVG("0_Avg-Duration_s") * 1000.0 AS avg_duration_ms FROM app_0 WHERE instr(experiment, '_') > 0 GROUP BY rep, state, var_nodes, msg_size ORDER BY length(rep), rep, state
